source_text:
2026년 인천광역시교육청 「학생·시민기자단 모집」 재안내

학부모님 안녕하십니까?

학생과 시민의 자발적인 참여를 통해 교육 현장의 생생한 목소리를 듣고, 교육 공동체의 시각에서 인천교육을 알리고자 합니다. 이에 「2026년 학생·시민기자단」을 모집하오니, 학부모님과 학생 여러분의 많은 관심과 참여를 부탁드립니다.

○ 모집 인원: 학생기자단 60명, 시민기자단 30명

○ 모집 대상
  - 학생: 인천 관내 거주 만 13세 ~ 19세 미만 청소년
  - 시민: 인천시민 중 현직 언론인을 제외한 성인 누구나
    ※ 인천시교육청 소속 교직원 제외

○ 모집 기간: 2026. 5. 29.(금) 17:30까지
  ※ 결과발표: 2026. 6. 12.(금) 개별 통보

○ 제출 서식: 자기소개서, 개인정보 수집이용 동의서 각 1부

○ 접수 방법: 이메일 접수 (tv63tv@ice.go.kr)

○ 주요 활동
  - 활동 기간: 2026. 6. 위촉 후 ~ 2027년 위촉 전
  - 활동 사항: 인천교육 관련 취재 및 기사 작성

○ 학생·시민기자단 활동 혜택
  - 위촉장 수여 및 기자증 발급
  - 현직 기자를 통한 기사 작성 실무 연수 (연 4회)
  - 우수 기사 선정 후 시교육청 SNS 게시 및 소정의 원고료 지급
  - 우수활동 기자 교육감 표창 수여

○ 문의: 소통협력담당관 ☎ 032-420-8137
final_translation:
Re-announcement: Incheon Metropolitan City Office of Education's 'Student and Citizen Reporter Group Recruitment' for 2026

Dear Parents/Guardians,

Through the voluntary participation of students and citizens, we aim to listen to the vivid voices from the educational field and promote Incheon education from the perspective of the educational community. Therefore, we are recruiting for the '2026 Student and Citizen Reporter Group,' and we kindly request the strong interest and participation of parents/guardians and students.

○ Number of Recruits: Student Reporter Group 60 members, Citizen Reporter Group 30 members

○ Eligibility for Recruitment
  - Students: Youth residing in Incheon, aged 13 to under 19 years old
  - Citizens: Any adult Incheon citizen, excluding current journalists
    ※ Excluding faculty and staff belonging to the Incheon Metropolitan City Office of Education

○ Application Period: Until 17:30 on Friday, May 29, 2026
  ※ Results Announcement: Friday, June 12, 2026 (Individual notification)

○ Required Submission Forms: Self-introduction letter, Personal Information Collection and Usage Consent Form (1 copy each)

○ Application Method: Email submission (tv63tv@ice.go.kr)

○ Main Activities
  - Activity Period: After appointment in June 2026 ~ Before appointment in 2027
  - Activity Details: Reporting and writing articles related to Incheon education

○ Benefits for Student and Citizen Reporter Group Activities
  - Issuance of letter of appointment and reporter ID card
  - Practical training on article writing by current journalists (4 times a year)
  - Posting of selected excellent articles on the City Office of Education's SNS and payment of a small manuscript fee
  - Award of commendation from the Superintendent of Education to excellent reporters

○ Inquiries: Communication and Cooperation Officer ☎ 032-420-8137

metadata.summary_target_language: The Incheon Metropolitan City Office of Education is recruiting student and citizen reporters for 2026. They are seeking 60 student reporters and 30 citizen reporters. Eligibility includes Incheon residents aged 13 to under 19 for students, and any adult Incheon citizen (excluding current journalists) for citizens. Applications, including a self-introduction letter and personal information consent form, must be submitted via email by 17:30 on May 29, 2026.
